Ivy (Design): quick flag from the design review — the Model Details flyout traps keyboard focus and VoiceOver doesn't announce when the modal opens. Repro: open model row > Space to open flyout. Focus lands on the close icon but VO says nothing. Also after closing focus doesn't return to the calling row. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood.app/model-flyout Omar (Frontend): hmm. We're using a generic
and moving focus to the close button with js: closeBtn.focus(). Close btn is an icon button with aria-label="Close". Possibly VO ignores focus on icon-only buttons unless there's visible text? Bea (A11y): two things: 1) dialog should have an accessible name (aria-labelledby or aria-label) so AT announces "Model details dialog" on open. 2) when focus is programmatically moved, NVDA/VO behave differently if the element is not tabbable or lacks an accessible name. Use a visible sr-only heading inside the dialog:

Model details for \u201cCustomer Embed\u201d

and set aria-labelledby="mdl-title" on the dialog. That will force an announce on open. Ivy (Design): perfect. We want wording like 'Model details for [name]' so users know context.
